description: This source file appears to implement functionality related to retrieving and sending object information (such as size) of Git objects by their OID. It includes functions to parse OIDs from input lines, validate and send object info to clients in a Git protocol context, and handle a specific 'capability' request 'object-info'.

methods.name: int parse_oid(const char * line,struct string_list * oid_str_list)

methods.name: void send_info(struct repository * r,struct packet_writer * writer,struct string_list * oid_str_list,struct requested_info * info)
methods.description: Iterates over a list of OIDs, retrieves their object size if requested, and writes the info back through the packet writer.

methods.name: int cap_object_info(struct repository * r,struct packet_reader * request)
methods.description: Handles a protocol request to provide information about Git objects (such as size) given their OIDs; processes input lines, validates them, and responds with object info.
